spec: GOVERNOR_MEETING v0.2.1 (design repo, private; D1469-D1475): Act 2 opens with Warden Ilse's call, the posting at the Lodge and the optional report after the Governor meeting. The meeting itself is hc_gov_meet in tools/build_hc_city.py.
_about: Ours, not a design copy. Applied after detail_zz_keeper_join.json (the file name sorts after it), so the Lodge keys below land after the join packet's old-save talk, the recall and the plain Cadet's send-off (linesBefore anchors on the enrolment key). Save stays pixelpets.save.v2, v 2; every flag here is a new additive story.* key. No @glimmer variant of these scenes exists (D1543, D1473).

_placeholders.note: PLACEHOLDER copy (Story/June to replace; GOVERNOR_MEETING §4 and §6.1 lines, OPEN_DECISIONS rows D1469-D1475). Every line in this file is a placeholder except Warden Ilse's a2_ilse_call, which Story signed (STORY_LINES D2139).

_route_hook: ROUTE_TO_GOVERNOR §6 (D1854, D1881, settled Nov 4, 2026): the first trip after the posting is on foot. The posting's line 4 is re-voiced to the walk; the quest rows gov_walk and gov_walk2 (quests.js) sit between gov_post and gov_meet; the coach hold, Porter Bram and Route 4 live in data/detail_zzzz_route4.json.

flags.story.a2_called: §4.1: Ilse's Act 2 Keeper1 call answered (the recall call writes it too: one call for a cover holder)
flags.story.gov_posted: §4.2: the posting at the Lodge; opens the Governor's House door (D1473)
flags.story.km_assigned: §5 step 9: the Governor's assignment, Kilnmouth (written by hc_gov_meet)
flags.story.gov_told: §5 step 7b (D1472): told / kept; unset when no ledger was seen. Lines only, never a report
flags.story.rpt_gov: §6.1 (D1474): the optional Lodge report after the meeting; its own guard, not a numbered report

calls._note: §4.1 (D1469): the first free outdoor step after the Episode 1 card. A cover holder (story.cover=glimmer, every new save under D1562) gets the join packet's recall call instead, which also writes story.a2_called: one call.

a2_ilse_call: Your Keeper1 buzzes in your pocket. WARDEN ILSE.
Cadet {name}. Well done at Brinewick. Come home to the Lodge. You have a posting.
Not on the wire. Come home.
a2_posting: Sit, Cadet. Brinewick reached me before you did. Good work, and quiet work. I like both.
The Governor's office asked for a Cadet. One who can listen. I gave them you.
A civil posting. You answer to his office, and to me. Nobody else signs for you.
Walk the coach road north to High Charity. The Governor's House, Charter Hill. They'll let you in.
And {name}? Come home after. Tell me what he asks. In person, not on the wire.
a2_report_gov: Kilnmouth. The springs and the seat. He gave a new Cadet a whole town. Interesting.
The tower's permit is in order. I keep hearing that, from people who never ask who signed it.
You told him about the ledger. Then we'll see where his asking goes, and who answers.
You kept the ledger back. Good. Paper travels further than people think.
Go on to Kilnmouth. And come home after. This is still your home.

objPatch._note: §4.2 and §6.1: Ilse's Act 2 keys go after the join packet's rpt_old, recall and cadet_sendoff keys (so an old save's Lodge talk, the recall and the plain Cadet's R3 always play first; the posting plays on the next talk, T6) and before its Act 1 keys and the built story.dream_woke line.

add.story.gov_posted & !story.hc_gov_met: The Governor's House, on Charter Hill. Go on, Cadet.
